target.name: Tyrosine-protein kinase JAK2 (CHEMBL2971)
target.notes: Ligand-based campaign. There is no receptor and no docking: the readout is the QSAR oracle in data/oracles/jak2_extratrees.joblib, fitted to 8,377 enzyme-format JAK2 pIC50 measurements. Held-out generic-Bemis-Murcko scaffold R2 0.608 +/- 0.021, RMSE 0.678, rho 0.784; assay noise ceiling 0.930. Growth-vector and pose terms are inert here by design. SEED: a real, measured, low-potency JAK2 inhibitor -- pIC50 5.88, 28 heavy atoms -- from the oracle's own training set, picked by screening 60 such compounds for reachable-space size and applicability-domain coverage. Fragment seeds were tried first and failed: they reach a depth-2 space at median NN Tanimoto 0.30-0.36, where the oracle's rank correlation is only 0.35-0.50 and its bias is upward. This seed reaches median NN 0.53 at depth 2, 98% inside the domain, expected rho 0.68 / RMSE 0.86. Headroom: training median pIC50 7.26, max 10.97, so the seed starts 1.4 log units below the median and 5.1 below the best.
